name: Meteor Shower
primary:
Burning stones rain down on an area 10 blocks across around the aimed spot.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky: at least 10 blocks of air above the target, so it fails in caves and under roofs.
A meteor falls about three times a second. Each one explodes within 3 blocks:
• Damage 7 ❤ fire
• Heat 140: sets targets and the ground on fire
• Knocks back and leaves a small crater
self_description:
On you:
• Heat 60
• Stone skin (resistance III), 15 s
